I have examined the glom repository structure and identified the state of implementation:

**Completed:**
- Reviewed all test files - 72 tests pass (1 skipped due to missing yaml dependency)
- Examined `glom/__init__.py`, `glom/core.py`, `glom/cli.py`, `glom/mutation.py`, `glom/reduction.py`
- Identified existing specifier classes: `Coalesce`, `Assign`, `Check`, `Inspect`, `Call`, `Literal`, `Spec`, `Path`, `TType`, etc.
- Confirmed that `Coalesce`, `Assign`, and `Check` lack `__repr__` methods
- Created initial `glom/constants.py` file with backward compatibility setup for `consts`

**Pending Requirements:**
- [R1] CLI must accept Python-full specifications - Currently uses `ast.literal_eval` only in cli.py; needs modification to support full Python expressions
- [R2] Expose `Auto`, `Fill`, `Iter`, `Let`, `ROOT` as public API - These classes don't exist yet and need to be created
- [R3] Expose `Invoke` class and create `constants` (backward compatible with `consts`) - Need to finish constants module and create Invoke class
- [R4] Add `__repr__` to `Fill` - Class doesn't exist yet
- [R5] Add `__repr__` to `Assign` and `assign` - Class exists in mutation.py but no repr method
- [R6] Add `__repr__` to `Coalesce` - Class exists in core.py but no repr method
- [R7] Add `__repr__` to all public specifier types including `Auto` and `Check` - Many specifiers missing repr implementations

I need to:
1. Create new specifier classes (`Auto`, `Fill`, `Iter`, `Let`, `ROOT`, `Invoke`) in appropriate modules
2. Add `__repr__` methods to existing specifiers (`Assign`, `Coalesce`, `Check`, `Inspect`, `Call`, `Merge`, `Fold`, `Flatten`, `Sum`, `Literal`, `Spec`, `Path`, `Call`)
3. Finish/update `constants` module/attribute with backward compatibility
4. Update CLI to support `python-full` spec format using proper evaluation instead of just `ast.literal_eval`
5. Export all new items from `glom/__init__.py`
